propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0, 1, and 2 while legacy reconcile routes retain historical codes 3, 4, and 75 for compatibility.
A single typed _Disposition enum with separate canonical and legacy exit adapters must be consumed by both new bridge facades and retained reconcile paths without a divergent whitelist.
Production workflow must use canonical 0/1/2 contract with no legacy numeric case handling, while preserving paused-state commit-skip behavior.
Benign dispositions (converged, paused, in-flight, reschedule, phase-gate) must map to exit code 0 in canonical routes and legacy code 3/4/75 respectively.
All production deployment consumers of legacy exit codes 3/4/75 must be migrated or explicitly classified as compatibility-only; no unclassified production usage remains.
